content: GDXray+ (github.com/computervision-xray-testing/GDXray, GRIMA PUC Chile + BAM Berlin): 21,100+ X-ray images, Welds.zip 209MB direct Dropbox link in README, defect types include porosity/cracks/inclusions/lack of fusion. Repo GPL-3.0 but images free for research/educational use only, no redistribution or commercial use; cite Mery et al. 2015 JNDE 34:42. SWRD (Zhao 2025) offers 3,600+ seam weld radiographs, public via paper data-availability. Roboflow GDXray-segmentation 135 weld images CC BY 4.0. Kaggle casting dataset 7,348 images defective/non-defective.
